build_ICNet_backbone: build an ICNet backbone with a ResNet config for real-time semantic segmentation
run_ICNet_forward: run the ICNet forward pass on an input image tensor to get multi-scale features
create_ICNet_PPM: create the Pooling Pyramid Module inside ICNet using configurable pool scales
review_ICNet_conv_sub1: review the ICNet conv_sub1 light branch that downsamples input with stride 2 convolutions
summarize_ICNet_architecture: summarize the ICNet three-branch architecture with sub1, sub2, and sub4 feature extraction paths
